_doc: Planned silences for the Piltdown v3 voiceover, in seconds. They are inserted as real silence between synthesized clips, marked PRESERVE in the EDL and never offered as cuts. Keys: lead_in = silence before S01; para_gap / scene_gap / part_gap = defaults; after = silence after a given paragraph, keyed 'S10.1' = scene S10, paragraph 1 (1-based); tail = silence after the last line.

S01.1.why: Let the hook's question hang before the promise

S02.2.why: Title card and string sting (TITLE CARD cue)

S06.4.why: Land the 'what you hoped to hear' line

S07.3.why: 'He never said exactly where.' Plants the S19 loop; part transition

S10.1.why: Scripted BEAT: two seconds of silence

S12.4.why: 'Not yet proof of a fake.' Held revelation

S13.2.why: 'What if someone had planted the bones?' The question breathes

S16.4.why: Beat before the hook payoff line

S19.2.why: Loop payoff: only Dawson knew the second site

S20.2.why: Verdict and open question settle; part transition

S21.1.why: Fade to black before the single ask
